analysis_role: Specific falsification of supported H1 using the same fixed (+BIO15,-BIO1) branchwise transition-regime statistic after linear latitude/longitude residualization of both environmental axes.

interpretation.supported: In the strict n>=10 East-Asian panel, the fixed U->D transition-regime correspondence remains positive on every accepted topology and exceptional among all count-preserving state maps after removing linear latitude/longitude structure from BIO15 and BIO1.
interpretation.boundary: The n>=5 sensitivity is borderline at 41/792 = 5.18%, so the exact exceptional rank is not fully insensitive to expanded-panel composition. Passing the strict test rules out only a simple linear latitude/longitude explanation, not all regional, spatial, phylogenetic or historical confounding.
interpretation.synthesis: Together with the Japan-only failure and single-taxon deletion results, the supported object is a distributed East-Asian lineage/regional transition-regime correspondence that is not reducible to one taxon or a simple linear geographic gradient.

claim_ceiling: Present-day residual niche centroids are not historical transition-time environments.
Linear latitude/longitude residualization does not remove all spatial or regional confounding.
No result identifies BIO15 or BIO1 as a causal selective agent.
No result establishes rain/wetting, UV, pollination, selection, adaptation or fitness causation.
